_about: Common monsters that change, read by sim/AssetLibrary.cs and sim/Monsters.cs (docs/NATURE.md). monsters: the species of data/species.json that are monsters; lair is the sprite of their lair (nest, crypt, pit, cave, pool, cairn: made in scripts/render2d/sprite_atlas.gd), lair_name what the chronicle calls it, pool the mutations the species can go through, each once. mutations: adjective is added to the species' name ("Venomous Spider"); speed, roam, lifespan and spawn multiply (spawn: how fast lairs bring new ones); size and litter add; defend multiplies the chance people have to fight the monster off; ability: fire (what it kills burns) or plague (it carries a sickness of its own).

mutations.text: their bite now kills many of those who would have fought them off
they grow huge: no prey is too big for them
they run faster and range further
their hide turns blades, and they live longer
they carry a sickness in their bite
they learn to strike the unwary
